blocks.text: 1 Samuel 11 contains 15 verses. It opens with: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabesh-gilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee. It concludes with: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before Jehovah in Gilgal; and there they offered sacrifices of peace-offerings before Jehovah; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: First Samuel 8-12 preserves both severe criticism of Israel's request and positive divine selection and empowerment of Saul; the final form presents monarchy as permitted but covenantally accountable rather than simply good or evil.
